items.title: Kirk Cousins: Tosses two TDs in Minnesota return
items.description:
Cousins completed 21 of 31 passes for 207 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers. He added 11 rushing yards on three carries.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: David Montgomery: Status for Thursday to be determined
items.description:
Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans said Sunday that he's "not certain" if Montgomery (groin) will be able to play Thursday against Indianapolis, DJ Bien-Aime of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Justin Jefferson: Nine catches in reunion with Cousins
items.description:
Jefferson caught nine of 13 targets for 74 yards in Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers.

items.title: Pat Freiermuth: Active in Week 10
items.description:
Freiermuth (illness) is active for Sunday's game at Cincinnati, Teresa Varley of the Steelers' official site reports.

items.title: C.J. Stroud: Three more TDs in loss
items.description:
Stroud completed 20 of 38 passes for 211 yards with three touchdowns and one interception while adding three rushes for 20 yards in the Texans' 27-24 loss to the Browns on Sunday.
